text: When a bank outsources its customer calls, it hands the call center a playbook! Greet like this. Read this disclosure. Verify every caller. Never promise an instant refund. And that call center now has to hire, train and certify HUNDREDS of agents to follow it. Every call!

Today, that's a trainer, one mock call, and a gut feeling. Interviews never test the playbook. Certification doesn't scale. So the first REAL test is a live customer. And a skipped disclosure there? That's a compliance failure for the client.
AcuityVoice fixes that! Upload the client's playbook. It builds realistic callers for every call type, puts each candidate on a live voice call, and decides pass or fail. With evidence!

Watch! This is ApexPay's program playbook. A Word document, straight from the client. Upload it, and in about fifteen seconds, AcuityVoice finds all THREE call types. Disputes, lost cards, and late fees. For each one, the call flow, in order. The auto-fail steps, flagged critical: the recording disclosure and identity verification. The policies, with the exact numbers. And the objections callers will throw at you!

Every call type gets three levels. Level one, a cooperative caller, for practice. Level two, a frustrated caller. That's the hiring bar! Level three, a hostile caller. That's certification. One click, and that's NINE live scenarios, built from the client's own document!
Now, a candidate! Maria is applying for the ApexPay line. She gets level two: Marcus, furious about a two hundred dollar charge he never made. Listen to how Maria handles him.
And she passes the hiring bar! Both critical steps done. One hundred percent of the playbook. And every step is backed by her exact words, one click from that moment in the call.

Same caller. Different candidate. Under pressure, Sam promised the money back by Friday. The playbook forbids that! Hiring bar: NOT passed. And the report shows his exact words. Same test. Same bar. For every single applicant.

Under the hood, it's all Assembly A I. The Voice Agent API reads the playbook, and plays the caller. Universal three point five Pro transcribes every word, every um, every pause. And pass or fail is computed in code. Never guessed by a model.
For a call center, that means faster hiring, consistent certification, and proof for every client that the agents on their line follow their playbook!
AcuityVoice. Hear the call, BEFORE you make the hire!
